3 14-03-2024 Heard learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Abhimanyu Sharma, learned Additional P.P. for the State.
2. Records have been placed before this Court to consider the prayer for suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail during pendency of the appeal.
3. In the present case, the appellant has been convicted and sentenced vide order dated 20.01.2023 and 23.01.2023 respectively passed by learned Additional District and Sessions Judge-VII-cum-Exclusive Special Court (POCSO), Patna in Special POCSO Case No. 07 of 2021 arising out of Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB) No.293 of 2023(3) dt.14-03-2024 Dhanarua P.S. Case No. 07 of 2021 for the offences under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code (in short 'IPC') and Section 4(2) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (in shot 'POCSO') Act

. 
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that from the materials on the record it would appear that there is no iota of evidence to prove the guilt of the accused against all shadow of doubts.
It is submitted that the occurrence is of 05.01.2021 at about 10:00 pm, but the victim did not disclose it on her own to her parents.

The informant, who is father of the victim, has come out with a story that on 09.01.2021, this appellant had climbed at the roof of his house, but on hulla he jumped away whereafter his daughter started weeping and told the story regarding the occurrence which took place on 05.01.2021.
5. Learned counsel submits that the medical examination report does not corroborate the allegations of rape.
6. Learned Additional P.P. for the State submits that in this case the star witness is the victim herself who has been examined as PW-3 and she has withstood the test of cross- Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.293 of 2023(3) dt.14-03-2024 examination.

The victim is fourteen years old whereas this appellant was teaching her in the coaching as a mathematics teacher and it is because of this reason that when he gave a telephonic call to the victim on 05.01.2021 at 10:00 pm, the victim had gone outside her house whereafter she was taken away to a particular place and was subjected to rape.
7.
Having regard to the materials available on the record, we are not inclined to grant suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail during pendency of the appeal.
Prayer is refused.

8. Let the hearing be expedited.
9.
Liberty is granted to the appellant to make a mention for early hearing of the case.

(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) (Jitendra Kumar, J) Rishi/-
